summary: Press and hold to confirm, releasing early cancels. Logic only, visuals are yours.
overview: The classic hold-to-delete pattern that protects against an accidental tap doing something destructive. Purely logic and timing — the visual is an optional progress object, so you can use a ring, a bar or nothing.
useCases: Delete save, reset progress or any destructive action.
Confirming on a touchscreen where mis-taps are common.

params.tuning: Long enough to be deliberate, short enough not to feel broken. Around a second is typical.
Off keeps partial progress, so a player can build up across several presses — which usually defeats the point of the guard.

gotchas.title: Pointer exit cancels too
gotchas.body: Dragging off the button while holding counts as releasing, which is the conventional behaviour and surprising if you expected it to keep counting.
